questions: Were you fully aware of what was happening throughout the limb movements?
Could you voluntarily stop or suppress the movements?
Did you have an urge or warning immediately before they began?
Did the movements continue while you were asleep?
Did each episode follow the same pattern and begin suddenly?
Did the movements spread from the leg to the arm, face, or other side?
Were you confused, unusually sleepy, or unable to remember the event afterward?
Did you bite your tongue or lose control of your bladder during the episode?
Did you have new weakness, numbness, difficulty speaking, or visual loss before or after it?
Have you ever had seizures or similar episodes before?
Have you recently had a stroke, head injury, brain infection, or brain surgery?
Have you missed any antiseizure medicines or recently started, stopped, or changed any medicines?
